subject: Trial conversion: proposal for conversion credit / short extension
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brookline.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-18 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot wrap / conversion timing + ask

Hi Samir —

Great to see the pilot finishing up next week. Usage has been healthy and the team is seeing the latency improvements we discussed. Before we start the contract work I wanted to check your timing for a production start and whether a small conversion sweetener would help unblock procurement.

You mentioned budget cadence shifting into Jan — if it moves your close to Q1 would a conversion credit or a short-term extension on the trial help hit your internal ROI checklist? I can propose an offer that ties credits to a signed commitment (e.g., 12 months) if that helps with budget approvals.

If you can share the procurement timeline I’ll put together a concise proposal and loop in finance/ops for sign-off.

— Marcus
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW-Brookline-v1.pdf (draft SOW)

From: Samir Patel <samir@brookline.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-18 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap / conversion timing + ask

Thanks Marcus —

Timing: procurement wants a signed contract before the end of the month to include in Q4 spend. However, our legal needs a firm credit/offering line to justify the spend to finance — we were hoping for something like $8k in platform credit or a 60-day trial extension so we can validate two more integrations.

If you can get me an internal yes by Monday morning, I can fast-track procurement and legal. Otherwise we slip into Jan and the approval becomes slower.

Samir
VP Product, Brookline AI

Marcus —

Thanks for the quick ask and for modeling options. I’m generally supportive of a modest credit to keep the momentum — this is exactly the scenario we design credits for. My recommendation: offer $5,000 in platform credit plus a 30-day trial extension conditioned on a signed 12-month commitment. That reduces ARR risk while giving them runway.

Ben — please confirm if $5k sits in the quota for these deals or if you need a PO/advance to approve. If finance signs off we can send final terms to Samir this afternoon.
